content:
Maria: FYI — MeadowBank sent a 'due-diligence asklist' as an email attachment. They asked for a prioritized bundle of artifacts by EOD Wed. Key items called out: SOC2 report, KMS/HSM details, data residency commitments, network peering options, expected throughput for 1k/10k rps, POC test plan, pricing tiers for Dedicated vs Hosted, and support SLA.
Sam: Can you drop the exact asklist here or attach the file? :eyes:
Maria: Attached the email PDF in the thread and pasted the bullet list below. (See file: meadowbank_dd_asklist.pdf)
Maria: "1) Compliance docs (SOC2, ISO) 2) KMS/HSM architecture + key lifecycle 3) Data residency and encryption details 4) POC runbook + test cases 5) Throughput/latency numbers for 1k rps and 95p latency 6) Pricing examples (hosted per-token, dedicated reserved) 7) Support & SLA levels 8) Network peering / VPC diagrams"
Anya: I can assemble the compliance pack and the SOC2 cover page + cert. ETA tomorrow morning.
Sam: I'll own the POC runbook and throughput numbers. Quick Q: for the 1k rps ask, do they mean concurrent open websocket streams or simple single request/response?
Maria: In the email they wrote "sustained 1k rps on low-latency endpoints" — I think it's request/response at 95p. I'll confirm with the buyer.
Lee: For throughput numbers, we'll provide both Redwood Hosted numbers and a Dedicated baseline. I suggest we include two perf profiles: small prompt (128 tokens) and long context (2k tokens). Also include batching assumptions and quantization used.
Sam: Perfect. I'll add the test harness instructions and a simple locust script snippet. Paste below for quick review: `locust -f tests/locustfile.py --headless -u 1000 -r 50 --run-time 30m`
Anya: Pricing: I'll draft a short table showing hosted per-token estimate and a monthly reserved node example for Dedicated, plus burst pricing. Can we reuse the templated pricing sheet?
Maria: Yes, use the "enterprise-pricing-template-v2.xlsx" and mark the Dedicated example as "example only".
Lee: Security/KMS: we can provide KMS integration doc + HSM reference architecture. Note: for on-prem HSM we need legal signoff on the AUP — flagging ops.
Maria: Good call. Anya — please include a legal gating note about HSM ordering timeline.
Anya: Will do.
deploy-bot: A new file was uploaded: meadowbank_dd_asklist.pdf
Sam: Proposed send plan (short): 1) Security & Compliance pack (Anya) 2) KMS/HSM + legal note (Lee/Anya) 3) POC runbook + perf numbers (Sam/Lee) 4) Pricing table (Anya) 5) One-page exec summary (Maria). Aim to ship consolidated zip by Wed EOD.
Maria: Let's prioritize items 1–3 if we need to triage. If buyer pushes, we can follow up on diagrams.
Lee: Timeline check — I can get KMS doc + perf baseline by tomorrow afternoon. Sam, can you confirm locust script and run results by tomorrow evening?
Sam: Yep, I'll kick a baseline run tonight and share the CSV.
Maria: Thanks team. I'll confirm the definition of "1k rps" with the buyer and update this thread.
Anya: I'll assemble the bundle and drop a draft ZIP in the thread for review tomorrow AM.
Maria: Great. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
